title: How some political candidates and activists across ideologies and professions are pushing back on the spread of data centers and AI in the US (Andrew R. Chow/Time)
summary: Andrew R. Chow / Time: How some political candidates and activists across ideologies and professions are pushing back on the spread of data centers and AI in the US — One icy morning in February, nearly 200 people gathered in a church in downtown Richmond, Va. Most had awakened before dawn and driven in from across the state.
